reason: This thing sits directly in our order path and can block or pass trades, and it comes from a startup with no customers and no SOC 2 report. Our vendor-risk process would stop it before I could sign anything, free pilot or not.
objection: No SOC 2, no references and no security review history. If the proxy goes down or makes a bad call, our customers' orders stall or go through wrong, and I'm the one explaining it to FINRA.
would_change_my_mind: A completed SOC 2 Type II report plus two or three reference brokers already running it in production.
